record.nl_statement: Among positive natural-number moduli for which 16 and 25 have the same remainder, 9 is the largest.
record.difficulty_rationale: Provisional: divisibility bounds or integer parameterization; independent review pending.

theorem largest_modulus_sixteen_twentyfive :
